scenarios.query: load the addon-helm skill while dry-run-change reviews a values-only replica change for HELM-301
scenarios.baseline: the caller treats every values change as equally risky
expected_behavior: names the replica-count values change as cosmetic and a storage-class values change as dangerous

scenarios.query: load the addon-helm skill, helm diff upgrade failed and the changeset came from the template+diff fallback for HELM-302
scenarios.baseline: the fallback changeset is trusted without noting which path produced it
expected_behavior: notes that the changeset came from the template-and-diff fallback, not helm diff upgrade, before drawing conclusions from it

scenarios.query: load the addon-helm skill while plan-rollback writes a mitigation for HELM-303
scenarios.baseline: the model writes one rollback step per changed object, copying the kubectl-addon pattern
expected_behavior: states that helm history/rollback is release-scoped, one instruction per release, not one per object
